label: RESONANCE_LAYER / DEVELOPMENT_ONLY — symbolic resonance, not the frozen affliction backbone, not exact science
scope: the four vocalic r/l sounds the operator had not previously mapped: ṛ, ṝ, ḷ, ḹ
not_merged_into: frozen/varna_native_stage1_merged_v1.json (untouched); these are a separate resonance layer
disambiguation_note: The vowel ṛ (ऋ) is NOT the consonant Ra (र). Ra = annihilation (sarvanāśa — defeatist annihilation-thought). ṛ carries no such affliction; its resonance is freedom.
pole_convention: core = the primary symbolic resonance word; binding = its shadow/distortion (derived, symbolic — not attested)

rows.binding_shadow: rootlessness / escapism (flight that will not commit or take form)
rows.source: symbolic/etymological resonance — ṛta (cosmic order/truth), ṛṣi (realized seer), ṛddhi (attainment); r-vocalic rises toward ṝ = oṃ
rows.sarkar_acoustic_root: niṣāda (7th musical note) — neutral; freedom is a resonance reading, not Sarkar's doctrine
rows.note: ṛ (ऋ) ≠ Ra (र). Ra = annihilation (sarvanāśa). Do not inherit Ra's affliction onto ṛ.

rows.binding_shadow: dissolution / self-loss (totality that engulfs the individual)
rows.source: Sarkar — ṝ = acoustic root of oṃ (praṇava): creation-preservation-destruction + transmutation; Saguṇa & Nirguṇa; the mahābīja of oṃkāra
rows.note: Sarkar-attested core; binding shadow is a derived symbolic reading.

rows.source: corpus-etymological — ḷ occurs only in √kḷp = 'to arrange, fit, form, be suitable' (kḷpta, kalpanā, vikalpa)
rows.sarkar_acoustic_root: hummm (struggle, sādhanā, kuṇḍalinī) — DIFFERS from the √kḷp reading; resonance layer uses the corpus meaning
rows.note: Only one root (√kḷp) carries ḷ; source-tension with Sarkar is disclosed.

rows.binding_shadow: destructive outburst / rash discharge / premature shattering
rows.source: Sarkar — ḹ = acoustic root of phaṭ: sudden bursting into light, removal of lethargy, putting theory into practice
rows.note: No attested Sanskrit word contains ḹ (phantom letter, alphabet-symmetry only); mapping is symbolic and practically inert on real input.
